text:
Maya: Okay team — kickoff for 'playground demo' tutorial + benchmark webinar. Target audience: devs integrating LLMs. Goal: tutorial + mini-benchmark narrative + live demo. Thoughts?
Omar: Love it. Recommend short 20-min demo + 25-min Q&A. Speakers: Omar (prod demo), Chris (bench results/why it matters), Aisha (integration patterns).
Lucy: Reg 🚀 Webinar date? Also need registration page + lead form. Prefer Wed 3pm PT. Would that block anyone?
Chris: 3pm PT works. I'll finish benchmark run next Mon — perf vs model variants, cost per 1k tokens, p95/p50 latency. Will surface configs.
Maya: Nice. For benchmark narrative: emphasize predictable latency + cost controls. Callouts: batching, KV caching, dedicated vs hosted. Keep charts simple.
Aisha: On leads: suggested routing — use HubSpot form with hidden field 'interest=playground-demo', send qualified leads (>=15 attendees or demo requests) to Solutions queue. Also tag with utm_campaign=playground-demo.
Lucy: I'll build landing with Eventbrite embed + HS form. Example UTM snippet: ?utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=playground-demo
Omar: Can we gate the code? prefer repo public, but gating the sample dataset behind signup so we capture leads.
Maya: Agree keep tutorial code OSS, but optional 'sample dataset' artifact behind email capture. We'll add quickstart + one-click demo.
Chris: Benchmark script will be in repo under /bench. Will include commands: ```bash ./run_bench.sh --model redwood-small --seq 512 --batch 16```
Lucy: Marketing assets: blog post (launch post + TL;DR), tweet thread, Dev.to post, short YouTube demo. I'll draft blog and tweets. Need 2 quotes: one from engineering and one from product.
Omar: I'll draft product quote. Maya, can you ask Eng to provide 1-2 lines on reliability?
Maya: @eng-oncall can you chime in with a very short blurb about latency SLOs? (we just need 1-2 lines) :pray:
deploy-bot: Reminder: schedule webinar email send 48h before and 1h before — set in Campaigns.
Aisha: Routing checklist for leads -> HubSpot workflow -> tag -> notify SDRs. Will create playbook in Notion.
Maya: Nice. Can we set conversion KPI: 10% registrants -> demo request? Also track CTR on code link.
Lucy: I'll create UTM tracking matrix and share spreadsheet. Also A/B test subject lines: 'Ship LLM features faster' vs 'Run LLM inference with predictable latency'.
Omar: Timeline: draft assets by Thu, bench results Mon, rehearsal Tue, webinar next Thu. I'll add to calendar.
Maya: Perfect. I'll send a follow-up with assigned owners + deliverable checklist. Thanks all :heart:
